items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>The pCloud Pass password manager suffered a cyberattack, with users reporting that unknown devices had connected to their accounts even with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled. [...]</article>

items.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers. [...]</article>

items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. [...]</article>

items.title: Your Firewall Isn't Enough: The Hidden Risk of Unmanaged VMs
items.author: Sponsored by ISPsystem
items.content: <article>Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive access permissions can create security blind spots across IT infrastructure. ISPsystem explains how centralized infrastructure management, access controls, and resource lifecycle automation can help reduce these risks. [...]</article>

items.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars. [...]</article>
